rules.sentence: in an ordinary clone, where `git remote -v` prints three tokens per line, the origin URL is returned without "(fetch)".

rules.said:
AssertionError: assert 'ssh://git@de...t.git (fetch)' == 'ssh://git@de...oogletest.git'
Skipping 48 identical leading characters in diff, use -v to show
- gletest.git
+ gletest.git (fetch)
rules.sentence: in a treeless clone, where `git remote -v` adds "[tree:0]" after "(fetch)", the origin URL is returned without "(fetch)" or "[tree:0]".
